seo.metaDescription: Thực sử dụng các mẫu câu đơn giản để hỏi và trả lời.

IF.IFname: Green living: Trendy lifestyle or necessary responsibility?
IF.IFdes: Green living: Trendy lifestyle or necessary responsibility?

HD.HD-01: X
HD.HD-02: Topic
HD.HD-03: Green living: Trendy lifestyle or necessary responsibility?

HD.HD-01: X
1 | Present Simple | Diễn tả sự thật, thói quen hiện tại.
HD.HD-02: Why do people choose to live green nowadays?
HD.HD-03: To protect the environment.
HD.HD-04: Because they care about the planet.
HD.HD-05: It saves money and energy.
HD.HD-06: It’s a popular lifestyle.

HD.HD-01: 2 | Present Continuous | Diễn tả hành động đang diễn ra.
HD.HD-02: How are people changing their habits to live greener?
HD.HD-03: They are using less plastic.
HD.HD-04: People are cycling instead of driving.
HD.HD-05: Many are planting trees.
HD.HD-06: They are reducing waste.

HD.HD-01: 3 | Present Perfect | Diễn tả hành động đã xảy ra và ảnh hưởng đến hiện tại.
HD.HD-02: What green actions have people taken recently?
HD.HD-03: People have started recycling more.
HD.HD-04: They have switched to reusable bags.
HD.HD-05: Schools have taught eco habits.
HD.HD-06: Cities have banned plastic straws.

HD.HD-01: 4 | Present Perfect Continuous | Nhấn mạnh hành động kéo dài từ quá khứ đến hiện tại.
HD.HD-02: How long have people been practicing green living?
HD.HD-03: People have been living green for decades.
HD.HD-04: We have been reducing plastic since 2010.
HD.HD-05: They have been using solar power.
HD.HD-06: Communities have been organizing cleanups.

HD.HD-01: 5 | Past Simple | Diễn tả hành động đã xảy ra trong quá khứ.
HD.HD-02: When did green living become popular in your area?
HD.HD-03: It became popular in the last five years.
HD.HD-04: My school started green projects in 2018.
HD.HD-05: People began caring more about nature.
HD.HD-06: Many switched to eco products.

HD.HD-01: 6 | Past Continuous | Diễn tả hành động đang diễn ra tại một thời điểm quá khứ.
HD.HD-02: What were people doing when the green movement started?
HD.HD-03: They were learning about climate change.
HD.HD-04: Factories were producing too much waste.
HD.HD-05: People were using plastic every day.
HD.HD-06: We were ignoring pollution problems.

HD.HD-01: 7 | Past Perfect | Diễn tả hành động xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ.
HD.HD-02: What had people realized before they chose to live green?
HD.HD-03: They had seen the damage to the Earth.
HD.HD-04: Scientists had warned about climate change.
HD.HD-05: News had shown extreme weather.
HD.HD-06: Schools had taught about nature protection.

HD.HD-01: 8 | Past Perfect Continuous | Nhấn mạnh quá trình kéo dài trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ.
HD.HD-02: How long had people been harming the environment before turning green?
HD.HD-03: They had been using plastic for years.
HD.HD-04: We had been wasting water daily.
HD.HD-05: People had been polluting rivers.
HD.HD-06: Cities had been cutting too many trees.

HD.HD-01: 9 | Future Simple | Dự đoán tương lai đơn.
HD.HD-02: What will happen if more people live green?
HD.HD-03: The planet will be cleaner.
HD.HD-04: Pollution will decrease.
HD.HD-05: Future generations will benefit.
HD.HD-06: Nature will be better protected.

HD.HD-01: 10 | Be Going To (Future Intentions) | Nói về dự định có kế hoạch trong tương lai.
HD.HD-02: What are you going to do to live greener?
HD.HD-03: I’m going to use reusable bottles.
HD.HD-04: I’m going to recycle more.
HD.HD-05: I’m going to save electricity.
HD.HD-06: I’m going to join tree-planting events.

HD.HD-01: 11 | Future Continuous | Dự đoán hành động đang diễn ra tại một thời điểm trong tương lai.
HD.HD-02: What will people be doing to support green living in 2035?
HD.HD-03: They will be using electric vehicles.
HD.HD-04: People will be growing food at home.
HD.HD-05: Schools will be teaching green habits.
HD.HD-06: Companies will be reducing plastic use.

HD.HD-01: 12 | Future Perfect | Dự đoán hành động hoàn tất trước một thời điểm tương lai.
HD.HD-02: What will we have achieved if everyone lives green?
HD.HD-03: We will have reduced global warming.
HD.HD-04: Forests will have recovered.
HD.HD-05: The air will have become cleaner.
HD.HD-06: The Earth will have become more sustainable.
